streak_lab.styles: SÌ button: bg-[#05A845] text-white hover:bg-[#048B39]. NO button: bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-300. Mock Google Login gate overlay over the arena.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS utility classes strictly. Apply `.js` component rules as Shadcn works nicely with standard React and Tailwind.
Implement the layout precisely matching the colors and typography described.
Create a vertical timeline with the thermometer indicators dynamically colored based on temperature prop.
Ensure 'Market Signals' use the dashed border style and orange tint.
Do not use dark mode or neon fuchsia; strictly stick to this Fantacalcio-inspired light, clean theme.
Use Phosphor icons or lucide-react for the thermometer, external links, and checkmarks.
